summary: Grupo Financiero Galicia S.A., an Argentine bank, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 2, 2026, solely to notify shareholders of a cash dividend distribution. The board resolved to pay Ps. 39,999,772,000 in total, split into three equal installments of Ps. 13,333,257,333.33. The first installment of Ps. 8.30084132575628 per share (par value Ps. 1.00) will be available from July 13, 2026, to shareholders of record July 6, 2026. This filing is a routine dividend notice, not a special situation event.
